qualification: Unauthenticated, TLS-verified requests from the audited origin with fake credentials; nothing is granted. An endpoint is direct when its real answer carries an allowing Access-Control-Allow-Origin and, where the request needs a preflight (a custom header such as Authorization), the preflight allows the origin and names the headers. Tenant endpoints answer for themselves and are not probed; only the family of hosts a tenant may live at is recorded.
